messages:
Alex: Just merged PR #4321 (model-serving). Main CI turned red right after merge — smoke e2e failing. Job: https://ci.internal/jobs/98765
CI Bot: Build 98765 • FAILED • smoke-gpu-e2e • failing test: tests/e2e/serve/test_kvcache.py::test_prefix_eviction
CI Bot: Log excerpt:
```
FAIL tests/e2e/serve/test_kvcache.py::test_prefix_eviction
E   AssertionError: expected 0 tokens but got 12
.../kvcache/alloc.cc: line 213: kvmem_alloc failed: no space for reserved pages
```
Sam: who owns kvcache/allocator area?
Rachel: that was me originally but I'm OOO this morning, I can take in ~2h if noone else picks up. :wave:
Alex: @Oncall (infra) can you grab for now? I can revert if it's urgent.
Oncall (infra): Taking it. Starting triage. First step: rerun failing job.
CI Bot: Rerun requested by Oncall (infra) • rerun job 98766 • status: queued
CI Bot: Rerun 98766 • FAILED • same test failing
Oncall (infra): Rerun failed with same trace. Tail shows allocator error repeated: `kvmem_alloc failed: no space for reserved pages`
Michael: That sounds like a reservation / sizing regression. Any recent commits touching kvcache/allocator?
Alex: My PR bumped default heuristics in allocator on the canary path, but it was gated. Another PR 4319 touched startup reservation logic and merged ~5 minutes before mine.
Michael: I'll bisect across the last 12 commits quickly. Running: `git bisect start HEAD origin/main~12` then `git bisect run ./scripts/e2e-smoke.sh --filter test_kvcache`
Michael: Found culprit: commit 9f2b3bd — "kvcache: reduce reserved pages on startup" — introduces aggressive trimming.
Oncall (infra): That matches the log (no reserved pages available). Two options: revert that commit or patch to increase reservation. Revert is faster to get main healthy.
Alex: I'll open an immediate revert PR for 9f2b3bd. Spinning it up now.
Alex: Revert PR opened: https://git.internal/p/4322 — reverting 9f2b3bd. CC: @Rachel
CI Bot: Pipeline started for PR 4322 (revert) • build 98770 • running checks
Rachel: Sorry again, will take follow-up once I'm back. If revert lands fine, I'll prepare a safer follow-up with tests for reservation sizing.
Sam: Good call reverting. We should add a smoke guard to detect kvmem reservation regressions in presubmit.
Oncall (infra): Monitoring CI and smoke. Will post updates if any further failures. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks everyone — keeping eyes on the revert pipeline. If it passes I'll merge and monitor main for 30m.
CI Bot: PR 4322 • pipeline PASSED • ready to merge
Alex: Merged revert. Main CI is green on quick smoke rerun. Will keep monitoring for 30m and follow up with a postmortem note.
Oncall (infra): Monitoring — no new alerts so far.
Michael: Nice catch + quick bisect.
Sam: Thanks team.
